measurement_protocol.order: odd pairs baseline/candidate; even pairs candidate/baseline
measurement_protocol.artifact_copy_protocol: shutil.copy2 both original artifacts into separate subdirectories of the same newly created temporary directory before measurements; checksums verified before and after copying and around every run
measurement_protocol.process_collection: subprocess.Popen + os.wait4; monotonic parent wall clock; Linux ru_maxrss in KiB
measurement_protocol.artifact_hashing: Streaming hashlib.file_digest in a fresh launcher process; no whole-binary read_bytes allocation
measurement_protocol.confidence_method: 20,000 seeded bootstrap resamples of 7 outer-pair median latency ratios; percentile 95% CI
measurement_protocol.regression_rule: Median candidate/baseline ratio >1.03 and bootstrap lower bound >1

component_summaries.note: Baseline interval below millisecond resolution; no ratio inference.

max_rss_kib.note: Conservatively censored: child max RSS overlaps launcher peak before fork; no engine memory ratio inference.

focused_storage_checks: NonNull pointer header and one-past full drain retain allocation provenance
reserve overflow preserves every live owner and shifted header
cached plain-descriptor proof fits existing InlinePacked padding with unchanged length/data offsets
inline and heap proof clones invalidate independently on foreign descriptor escape

limitations: Candidate is an integrated session snapshot; component scaling is not an isolated whole-engine attribution.
Date.now integer millisecond quantization limits small drain cases; the report includes a conservative +/-1 ms ratio envelope.
Seven outer pairs are the confidence resampling unit; the five samples within one process are not independent outer repetitions.
Peak RSS is for the complete fixture process, including startup, warm-up, construction, garbage collection and native compilation; it is not post-GC live memory.
This component comparison does not establish real-application, startup or compilation-volume acceptance.
Unshift is amortized O(items.length) for ordinary plain dense arrays; observable holes, descriptors, proxies and prototype writes retain their specified algorithm.

Peak RSS in this runner is censored by the roughly 22 MiB Python launcher residency at fork; raw RSS is retained, but valid_engine_memory_comparison is false and no engine memory ratio is inferred. Dedicated application/resource reports provide memory evidence.
